## 5. Technical Level Calculation Reference
All support and resistance key levels are calculated using classical intraday floor pivot formulas:
- **Pivot Point (P):** `(High + Low + Close) / 3`
- **Resistance 1 (R1):** `(2 * P) - Low` | **Support 1 (S1):** `(2 * P) - High`
- **Resistance 2 (R2):** `P + (High - Low)` | **Support 2 (S2):** `P - (High - Low)`
